senses.definition: So small or easy that it is not worth spending time on.
distractors: Deferred to a later release on purpose.
Cheap to build and expensive to run.
Left undone because nobody ever owned it.
Small in size but serious in what it sets off downstream.
Difficult to explain but easy to do once you have seen it.

senses.definition: Not simple, and harder or larger than the person asking has assumed.
distractors: Simple to describe and simple to build.
Impossible with the tools currently available at any price.
Expensive in money but cheap in the time it takes to finish.
Well understood by the team that owns it and by nobody else in the building.
Held up by a dependency on another team rather than by the work itself.
